qa_pair.question: In MCP actions fixture v1, inspect action discovery and owner route policy. Can an MCP bearer token approve its own payment or change the payment rules?
qa_pair.answer: No. Approval and payment-rule changes require the separate signed-in owner console.

qa_pair.question: In fixture v1, compare scope parsing with action tool discovery. Does an existing ecosystem:read connection automatically gain action execution?
qa_pair.answer: No. actions:prepare and actions:execute require explicit authorization.

qa_pair.question: In fixture v1, compare the proposal and execution handlers. What happens when an unapproved email proposal is executed?
In fixture v1, inspect the PostgreSQL concurrency scenario and payment policy. With a 150-minor-unit daily cap, can two distinct 100-minor-unit payments both receive approval?
qa_pair.answer: One approval succeeds; the other exceeds the daily cap.

qa_pair.question: In fixture v1, compare the execution claim and receipt-failure tests. Can repeating a claimed action after its final receipt write fails dispatch the provider a second time?
qa_pair.answer: No. The durable executing claim prevents another dispatch.

qa_pair.question: In fixture v1, inspect deletion preview and execution. Does delete_draft erase user content or delete a VPS?
qa_pair.answer: No. It archives an owned wiki draft and retains its content.

qa_pair.question: In fixture v1, compare repair provider execution and merge policy. Does creating a repair PR prove the code passed tests or repaired the live site?
qa_pair.answer: No. Tests, merge and deployment verification remain separate.

In fixture v1, compare payment rules with dispatch preflight. What source-account or live/test-mode mismatch is permitted?
qa_pair.answer: None. The mismatch blocks the transfer before payment dispatch.

qa_pair.question: In fixture v1, inspect uncertain-payment state and the business-reference guard. Can a fresh request key bypass a pending, uncertain or completed payment with the same payee and reference?
qa_pair.answer: No. The duplicate payment reference remains blocked.
